product_metadata.title: mDesign Large Metal Wire Kitchen Countertop, Sink Dish Drying Rack with Removable Plastic Cutlery Tray Caddy and Drainboard with Adjustable Swivel Spout - 3 Pieces - Bronze/Sand Brown
features: LARGE CAPACITY DISH DRAINER: Ample room for drying dishes, glassware, tableware, cutting boards, pots and pans; Features 13 slots in the metal rack for dishes and 14 hooks on the sides for hanging wine glasses, tumblers, mugs and more; A removable BPA free, food safe flatware caddy is divided into 3 nicely sized compartments to separate and air dry silverware, flatware, serving utensils and other cutlery pieces; The cutlery caddy is designed to work with the drainboard and stay in place

ADJUSTABLE WATER DRAINAGE SPOUT: Adjustable water spout moves 360 degrees and can be positioned on 3 different sides of the drainboard to send water directly into the sink; This gives you several placement options to best fit your kitchen and sink environment and will help to keep water in the sink and off your counters; Place this versatile drying rack where it works best for you

CLEAN COUNTERS: This 3-piece dish drainer with drainboard is the perfect complement to busy kitchens everywhere; Generously sized and beautifully styled - it will keep your kitchen countertops free from drips and spills and make washing dishes less of a chore; Multiple positioning options allow you to create a dish drying station that looks custom-made for your kitchen

QUALITY CONSTRUCTION: The dish rack is made of strong steel wire with a durable rust-resistant finish; The removable silverware caddy and the drain board are made of durable BPA and Chlorine free shatter-resistant plastic; Food safe; Easy Care - clean with mild soap and water; Do not place in dishwasher
THOUGHTFULLY SIZED: Measures 17" x 13.38" x 5.95" high
